Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class ChatView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.ChatView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Refreshable, javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class ChatView extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox implements Refreshable
The chat screen, the same in the buyer and seller portals (UC6 Chat About Listing; Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): the history of messages and offers with sender and time, a box to write a message, and a search of the history that jumps to the chosen message and highlights it. A chat is shown in the chat screen, ChatList, beside the user's other chats: 

 Conversation chat = chatService.openForOffer(offer.getId());       // or openForListing(listingId)
 new ChatList(chatService, host, onOpen).openFrom(chat, "Back to Offers & Requests", back);

Deal actions. The offers in the history only show what happened and their status. What can be done with them is in one row under Send, the same in both portals, and a button is there only while it is that person's turn (assumptions register 71):

  • the buyer portal adds Make Offer with setOnMakeOffer(java.lang.Runnable) and, while the seller has countered, Agree to Counter with setOnAgreeToCounter(com.hkust.marketplace.ui.ChatView.AgreeToCounter) (UC5 step 1). Agree to Counter opens OfferChoiceDialog, which lists the countered offers and returns the one chosen;
  • the seller portal adds Respond in Offers & Requests with setOnRespondToOffers(com.hkust.marketplace.ui.ChatView.RespondToOffers): a link, not an answer. The seller answers offers only on Offers & Requests (Task 2.5; Manage Offers & Requests 3.3-3.5), so the chat does not repeat that screen's actions.

All rules (who may read and write, empty messages, searching, which offers allow which action) are in the tested ChatService, Conversation and OfferAction; the wording is in ChatText and OfferText. This class only lays the chat out.

  • Method Details

    • conversation

      public Conversation conversation()
      The chat this screen shows, as it was last loaded: the listing it is about and the people in it.

    • setOnMakeOffer

      public void setOnMakeOffer(Runnable makeOffer)
      Adds the Make Offer option for the buyer (UC5 step 1: "the Make Offer option in the listing's chat thread"), named after the listing type: Make Offer, Request Borrow or Claim Item. The action runs Make Offer; afterwards the history is reloaded, so a new offer appears in it. Nothing is shown when the viewer is the seller.

    • setOnAgreeToCounter

      public void setOnAgreeToCounter(ChatView.AgreeToCounter agree)
      Adds Agree to Counter for the buyer (UC5 step 1: "choosing to agree to a seller's counter on one of their earlier offers"). The button is shown while the seller has countered one of the buyer's offers in this chat, with how many: "Agree to Counter (1)". It opens the list of countered offers, each with the buyer's terms and the seller's counter, and Agree runs agree. Nothing is shown when the viewer is the seller.

    • setOnRespondToOffers

      public void setOnRespondToOffers(ChatView.RespondToOffers respond)
      Gives the chat the seller's link to Offers & Requests. While the chat has open offers, the seller sees "Respond in Offers & Requests (n)", which calls respond with them. The chat never shows the seller Accept, Decline or Counter. Without the link, or when the viewer is the buyer, nothing is shown.

    • setOnHistoryChanged

      public void setOnHistoryChanged(Runnable changed)
      What else follows when the user's own action changes this chat's history: a message sent, or an offer made with Make Offer or Agree to Counter. The chat screen (ChatList) reloads its list of chats, so this chat moves to the top (assumptions register 90).
